title: Directed affine global-section continuity with Grothendieck coefficients
statement: Let A be a Grothendieck abelian category [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian], J a small nonempty directed preorder, D:J^op -> Sch a diagram of affine schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and c a limiting cone. Let pi:D -> const S be a compatible family of structure maps to an affine scheme S and p:c.pt -> S their limit map. For a small-etale A-valued sheaf G on S [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], consider any supplied diagram H:J -> A identified objectwise with Gamma(D_j, pi_j^* G) [def-weil-pbc-global-sections-functor]. Assume its transitions are the adjunction-unit global-section maps followed by inverse-image composition. Let K be a supplied cocone whose point is identified with Gamma(c.pt, p^* G) and whose legs are those same canonical maps for the cone projections. Then K is a colimit. The normalization equalities and all their directions are exactly those in the Lean statement.

proof.text: Work on the affine etale bases over the fixed affine base S and over the affine stages. Affine etale finite-presentation objects at the limit, their arrows, equalities, finite covers, and covering pullbacks descend simultaneously to sufficiently late stages. Their model categories are filtered, and later-stage restrictions are independent of every choice by eventual equality. The later base changes of any fixed model are cofinal among all models, by descent of comparison maps and eventual equality. This computes each required colimit over a u-small upper tail.

For each limit affine etale object V form Q(V) as the filtered colimit in A over all its stage presentations of the stage inverse-image sections. Lift arrows at common stages and use the colimit universal property for restrictions. Descend a finite affine cover together with its matching diagram. AB5 commutes its finite matching limit with this filtered colimit, so Q is a sheaf on the affine etale basis; the empty cover gives zero. Extend along the affine basis equivalence.

Write p_j for the limit projection. A morphism from Q to M is a compatible family of morphisms pi_j^*G -> (p_j)_*M. By the stage adjunction these are morphisms G -> (pi_j)_*(p_j)_*M; composition of direct images identifies these Hom sets and their transition maps with the constant set Hom(G,p_*M). Directedness and nonemptiness identify a compatible family with one such morphism. Identity presentations and adjunction units show the constructions are inverse, identifying Q with p^*G and its comparison maps with the canonical units. Evaluate at the terminal affine object and transport by the supplied component and point isomorphisms. This proves the universal property of K without choosing arbitrary data from a holed existence theorem.

lean.statement:
theorem affine_globalSections_limit_isColimit_of_directed
    {J : Type u} [Preorder J] [IsDirected J (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty J] {S : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsAffine S]
    (D : Jᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) [∀ j, IsAffine (D.obj j)]
    (π : D ⟶ (Functor.const Jᵒᵖ).obj S) (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c)
    (p : c.pt ⟶ S) (hp : ∀ j : J, p = c.π.app (op j) ≫ π.app (op j))
    (G : Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology A) (H : J ⥤ A)
    (e : ∀ j : J, H.obj j ≅ (Sheaf.Γ (D.obj (op j)).smallEtaleTopology A).obj
      ((upperStar A (π.app (op j))).obj G))
    (hH : ∀ (j k : J) (f : j ⟶ k), H.map f ≫ (e k).hom =
      (e j).hom ≫ globalSectionsUpperStarMap A (D.map f.op)
        ((upperStar A (π.app (op j))).obj G) ≫
      (Sheaf.Γ (D.obj (op k)).smallEtaleTopology A).map
        ((upperStarComp A (D.map f.op) (π.app (op j)) (π.app (op k))
          (by simpa only [Functor.const_obj_obj, Functor.const_obj_map,
            Category.comp_id] using (π.naturality f.op).symm)).inv.app G))
    (K : Cocone H) (eK : K.pt ≅ (Sheaf.Γ c.pt.smallEtaleTopology A).obj
      ((upperStar A p).obj G))
    (hK : ∀ j : J, K.ι.app j ≫ eK.hom =
      (e j).hom ≫ globalSectionsUpperStarMap A (c.π.app (op j))
        ((upperStar A (π.app (op j))).obj G) ≫
      (Sheaf.Γ c.pt.smallEtaleTopology A).map
        ((upperStarComp A (c.π.app (op j)) (π.app (op j)) p (hp j)).inv.app G)) :
    Nonempty (IsColimit K)
